# №623 (gh#1086): the checked-in floor of the PARAMETERIZED typed-share
# metric — the THIRD metric beside the general (№467) and the precise
# (№560) ones.
#
# Generated by: python3 scripts/ci/type_signature_share.py --parameterized
# The denominator: every TYPED registry row whose base type (before `<`)
# is List or Struct (the audit t94 base: 84 bare rows); the numerator:
# the rows carrying the parameterized spelling `List<T>` / `Struct<Name>`
# (the stage-0 enum erases the parameter — the metric and the spec!
# string are where the parameter lives).
#
# The Z-2 verdict (the unified audit e40ce8e; gh#1077 superseded) stopped
# the precise-share movement by bare scalars: THIS metric is where the
# typed movement of the 0.30 cycle lives. The dispatch В34 owner-gate 2:
# the 0.30 gate's typed parameter is THIS share (the draft benchmark
# ≥ 50% of the List/Struct rows — the value is the OWNER's, ADR-0186 §3).
#
# A share BELOW threshold_bp fails CI. A raise happens in the same PR
# that parameterizes more rows — never by loosening the spelling.
# The X-3 rule: the floors sit strictly above the live facts.
#
# History (the machine tells the raise, the naryad orders it):
# threshold_bp: 769 — №623: parameterized 7 | List/Struct rows: 91
#   (the first honest package: mcp_list_tools List<Tool>, form_data
#   Struct<FormData>, json_body Struct<JsonBody>, geo_ip
#   Struct<GeoLocation>, weather Struct<Weather>, weather_forecast
#   List<DayForecast>, llm_usage Struct<LlmUsage>; the honest
#   exclusions: respond/respond_html — the opaque HttpResponse;
